html:
Sightseeing Highlights

  • Walk through the little alley streets of Hanoi Old Quarter. Enjoy the delicious food.

  • Take an overnight train ride to Sapa, visit the villages and stilt houses, experience life with the highland people.
  • Experience sleeping overnight on a cruise, admiring the beauty of Halong Bay.

  • Explore Hue’s Forbidden Purple City. Enjoy a vegetarian meal at a Buddhist temple.

  • Experience climbing the Marble Mountain in Da Nang, visit the ancient town of Hoi An and enjoy the delicious food in the town..

  • Visit Tra Que village. Take part in a fun farming lesson.

  • Discover the underground Cu Chi tunnels, visit the Notre Dame Cathedral, the Reunification Palace in Ho Chi Minh City

  • Discover the beauty of the Mekong Delta.

Dining Experience

  • 11 hotel buffet breakfasts.
  • 5 dinners and 6 lunches at well-selected restaurants
  • 2 street food tours

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C train, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, the entry visa to Vietnam, personal expenses, tips to guide and driver.
